items.label: Wide scene
items.instruction: Photograph both cars from a safe position, with both vehicles and the gap between them in one shot.

items.label: Witness details
items.instruction: Ask the witness for their name and a phone number, if it is safe to do so.

items.label: Other vehicle plate
items.instruction: Photograph the other vehicle plate from where you can safely stand.

items.label: Other driver insurance
items.instruction: Ask for the other driver insurance details. Record them only if they agree.

items.label: Other vehicle damage
items.instruction: Photograph the other vehicle damage from a safe position.

items.label: Your vehicle damage
items.instruction: Photograph your vehicle damage from a safe position.

items.label: Parking location
items.instruction: Photograph the parking bay number and nearby location marker in one shot.

items.label: Potential footage
items.instruction: Record the location of any visible camera and the contact details of the site operator.

items.label: Object involved
items.instruction: Photograph the bollard or other object involved from a safe position.

items.label: Scene visibility
items.instruction: Photograph the view along your approach from a safe position.

items.label: Your account
items.instruction: Describe what happened in your own words. Include only what you remember.
